Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Sara, Rodrigo Duterte hid P96M through unutilized manager’s checks — prosecution

blocks.text: Prosecutors present P96-M in manager’s cheques as they sought to establish a ‘pattern of concealment’ with year-end balances of Vice President Sara Duterte and her father, former president Rodrigo Duterte.

items: With finality: COA affirms disallowance of Sara Duterte’s P73-M confidential funds

blocks.text: The Commission on Audit affirms with finality the disallowance of the Office of the Vice President’s P73-million confidential funds under Vice President Sara Duterte.

items: Leandro Leviste ordered arrested by Makati City court

blocks.text: A Makati City court orders the arrest of Batangas 1st District Representative Leandro Leviste over alleged violation of the Public Service Act.

items: On day one, rush for GCash IPO shares briefly trips up trading systems

blocks.text: At least one trading platform is briefly overwhelmed as investors rush to buy shares in the initial public offering or I.P.O. of Mynt, the parent company of GCash.

items: Unemployment eases to 5.3% in August 2026 as agriculture adds jobs

blocks.text: The Philippines’ unemployment rate eases to 5.3% in August 2026 as more Filipinos found work, particularly in the agriculture sector. – Rappler.com
